ledger: hand | positioned over left green '2' cube | positioned over rightmost blue '6' cube | sequentially moves each rightmost cube one position to the right, rotating cubes to show different faces

number cubes | 2 green cubes with '2' face forward and metal tops | 8 multicolored cubes (blue, green, orange, light blue) with numbers 2,3,5,6 face forward and metal tops | total count increases from 2 to 8 as new cubes appear in the original position of each moved cube

findings.description: The total number of cubes increases repeatedly as the hand moves each rightmost cube to the right. A new cube appears in the original position of each moved cube, growing the total from 2 to 8 cubes without any new cubes being introduced from off-screen, which is physically impossible.
